notes.title: The Game has participated in the Steam Festival!Release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
My first game has officially launched at the Steam Festival! 

The game DEMO is also available for a trial! I've also created a new promotional video! 

I hope everyone will enjoy it!

with an initial discount of 20% at $2.4 USD!
